description: Stage prompts, finalize completed turns, and recover missed work before compaction.

hooks.command: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python -X utf8 -c "import os,runpy,sys; from pathlib import Path; scripts=Path(os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'])/'scripts'; sys.path.insert(0,str(scripts)); runpy.run_path(str(scripts/'user_prompt_submit.py'),run_name='__main__')"

uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python -X utf8 -c "import os,runpy,sys; from pathlib import Path; scripts=Path(os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'])/'scripts'; sys.path.insert(0,str(scripts)); runpy.run_path(str(scripts/'stop.py'),run_name='__main__')"

uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python -X utf8 -c "import os,runpy,sys; from pathlib import Path; scripts=Path(os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'])/'scripts'; sys.path.insert(0,str(scripts)); runpy.run_path(str(scripts/'pre_compact.py'),run_name='__main__')"
